occurrences.text: Canonical storage is `.anix/state.sqlite`. `Workspace::open` checks legacy `.rn` before creating the canonical store. If only legacy exists, a single directory rename moves database, WAL, shared-memory file and operational artifacts together. No competing database copy is created. A locked/failed rename returns an error instead of opening an empty replacement database.
